_about: Keyword -> DM rules for @hemanth_chakka. Every DM is put together fresh from the pieces below (greeting + reel line + ask/intro + closing), so no two DMs read the same. The resource text itself (dm) stays fixed so the facts never drift. Placeholders: {name} first name (only used when we have one), {thing} the resource name, {topic} the reel the person commented on.
_send_words_note: 19 Nov, owner said yes: a comment like 'Send' (no keyword) gets the resource the post's own caption asks for (Comment SAFE -> the SAFE card). On a post whose caption asks for no keyword, nothing is sent.

rules.name: family safety card
public_replies: Sent. If you don't see it, check message requests
On its way to your inbox
rules.dm:
🛡️ Family safety card
WhatsApp > Settings:
1. Privacy > Calls > Silence unknown callers ON
2. Privacy > Advanced > Protect IP address in calls ON
3. Account > Two-step verification > set a PIN
4. Family group > tap its name > Advanced chat privacy ON
Panic call asking for money, even in a voice you know? Ask your family code word. No word = hang up, call back on the saved number.
"Power cut tonight, call this officer" SMS = scam. Never install AnyDesk for anyone.
Money lost? Call 1930 right away.
outros_unused: Send it to the family group, it helps more there 🙏
If your parents use WhatsApp, set these on their phone this weekend.
Forward it to whoever handles Amma's phone 🙂
Stay safe! Any doubt, just reply here.
Takes 2 minutes to set up. Worth it.
Share it with the one person in your family who forwards everything 😄

rules.name: list of 10 ChatGPT codes
public_replies: Sent. Check message requests if you don't see it
Check DMs, the list is there
rules.dm:
10 ChatGPT "codes" that work (plain words, any AI):
1. Devil's advocate: [your idea]
2. Explain like I'm 10, with a daily-life example: [topic]
3. Quiz me on [topic], 5 questions, one at a time
4. Answer in 3 lines: [question]
5. Make this a table: [messy info]
6. Give me 3 really different options: [task]
7. What am I missing? List the risks: [plan]
8. Check this and explain each fix: [your text]
9. Rewrite this, simple and polite: [message]
10. Ask me questions first, then answer: [problem]
Save your favourites in Settings > Personalization > Custom instructions.
outros_unused: Try number 1 tonight and tell me what it said 😄
Save your favourites in a note, you'll use them daily.
Which one worked best for you? Reply and tell me.
These work in Gemini too, not just ChatGPT.
Number 7 is my favourite before any big decision.
Send it to the friend who always gets essays back 😄

extra.SAFE: Bonus from the reel: photo looks too wild? Gemini > add the photo > ask "Is this AI-generated?". No mark doesn't mean it's real, so check the news before you forward.

_follow_gate_note: 19 Nov test: Meta lets this app send ONE private-reply DM per comment, but refuses any follow-up message (code 10, outside allowed window) and the follow check (code 230), even after the person replies. A follow gate needs Meta app review (Advanced Access + messaging webhooks). Until then follow_gate stays false: the resource goes in the one DM, with a follow nudge.
follow_nudges: Hope you will follow me for such more updates on time
